text: follow-on: the rename reverses the naming order the plan itself states and the order the earlier jtmm-differential-loop-store node landed under review. Plan section 6 line 552 reads 'a type-6 entry naming loop 7 then loop L', which is the DD index order (indices_differential is [7, L]); the reviewed head names the same entries FL<L>-FL7, so the name order is now the reverse of indices_differential. The store node's 115/120 review (comment 1959) records its choice as 'naming [7,L]' with the DD index order. Both spellings are defensible -- the new name reads as the stored difference psi_L - psi_7, the old one listed the pair in DD index order -- but only one can hold, and the dispatch goal ('so the name reads as its stored difference') overrides the plan text without the plan recording the change. Follow-on for the coordinator: update plan section 6 line 552 and record the naming-order decision so the store node's landed convention is not left silently contradicted.

justifications.reuse: No new reader, abstraction or module: the converter reuses the merged build_magnetics write path, the binding regeneration adapts the existing staged builder rather than adding a second path, and the tests reuse existing fixtures and constants.
